sources.title: Jackrong/Qwopus3.5-4B-Coder-MTP-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🧠 1.1 Base Model Specifications (Qwopus3.5-4B-Coder) Qwopus3.5-4B-Coder inherits the compact Qwen3.5 4B dense architecture and adapts it toward agentic coding, debugging, tool routing, and long-form reasoning. The 4B size is intended to keep the model deployable on local machines while retaining enough reasoning capacity for developer workflows.

sources.title: Jackrong/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 💡 What is DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-4B? DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-4B is a reasoning-focused fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B, distilled from responses generated by DeepSeek-V4-Pro in Max Effect mode. It follows the same training pipeline and approximately 250,000-sample mathematics and STEM mixture used for the 9B release, while targeting a substantially smaller and more accessible deployment class.
